I'm Sebas Eliëns, an independent data scientist and AI engineer based in the Netherlands. My background is in physics, and I've been working in data since [year].

My main focus recently has been AI engineering at Alef Education, where I work on an agentic AI assistant for teachers. I've also spent a significant part of my career in educational assessment — building computerised adaptive testing systems and advising on psychometrics, mainly using item response theory.

I care about work that is honest, reproducible, and useful.

Outside of work: I've fallen in love in and with Brazil, enjoy running, surfing, and diving, and hold a second dan in Shorinji Kempo.
